note: Phase-2 real KPI set: 13 KPIs. Same shortlist is compared under each active criterion.

indicators.name: Primary Energy [kWh/m2]
indicators.description: Annual total primary energy at building level; measure of overall energy efficiency.
indicators.info: Total primary energy used by the building over a year, combining renewable, delivered and exported energy flows.

indicators.name: Demand Response [%]
indicators.description: Reduction of hourly power consumption achieved through demand response strategies (e.g., price signals, variable setpoints).
indicators.info: How much hourly power consumption can be reduced through demand response strategies such as price signals or adjusted temperature setpoints.

indicators.name: Energy Shift Flexibility Factor [%]
indicators.description: Flexibility of energy use with respect to electricity pricing periods; ratio of shifted energy between low- and high-price periods.
indicators.info: How much energy use is shifted to low electricity-price periods instead of high-price periods.

indicators.name: No Grid Interaction Probability [--]
indicators.description: Probability that the building is acting autonomously of the grid over the evaluation period.
indicators.info: How often the building can operate autonomously, without exchanging energy with the grid.

indicators.name: Load Cover Factor [--]
indicators.description: Percentage of load demand covered by on-site renewable generation, including storage effects and losses.
indicators.info: Share of the building load covered by on-site renewable generation, including storage effects and losses.

indicators.name: Load Matching Index [%]
indicators.description: Average coincidence between building load and on-site renewable generation across all time steps.
indicators.info: How well building load and on-site renewable generation coincide over time.

indicators.name: SAIDI [h/year·customer]
indicators.description: Average total duration of supply interruptions experienced per customer per year.
indicators.info: Average total duration of energy supply interruptions experienced per customer in a year.

indicators.name: Predicted Percentage Dissatisfied (PPD) [%]
indicators.description: Percentage of people predicted to be thermally dissatisfied; derived from the PMV index.
indicators.info: Predicted share of occupants dissatisfied with the thermal environment.

indicators.name: Indoor Overheating Degree [--]
indicators.description: Degree-hours weighted measure of overheating across all occupied building zones.
indicators.info: Accumulated overheating above comfort limits across all occupied zones.

indicators.name: Investment cost [euro]
indicators.description: Capital expenditure (CAPEX) for the implementation of ENTRANCE technologies and solutions at the building or district level.
indicators.info: Upfront capital expenditure to implement the renovation technologies and solutions.

indicators.name: Specific cost of flexibility [c euro/kWh]
indicators.description: Ratio between the extra cost incurred by load shifting and the amount of electricity shifted relative to the reference scenario.
indicators.info: Extra cost of load shifting per unit of electricity moved away from peak periods.

indicators.name: Net Present Value (NPV) [euro]
indicators.description: Present value of future cash flows including the initial investment.
indicators.info: Overall economic value of the renovation: future earnings discounted to today, minus the initial investment.

indicators.name: Simple Payback Period (SPP) [years]
indicators.description: Time for cash inflows to equal the initial cost.
indicators.info: Number of years until the renovation pays for itself through savings and earnings.
